title: ACHIRI — Fix /achiri-launch E2E test check: passed is numeric not boolean
description: Bug: cmdAchiriLaunch() checks r.passed === true to determine E2E test pass. But reports/achiri-e2e-latest.json has 'passed: 33' (number of tests passed, not a boolean). Fix: use !!r.passed truthy check, or check typeof r.passed === 'number' && r.passed > 0. This makes /achiri-launch Step 1 E2E show ✅ instead of ⚠️.

tasks.title: Fix cmdAchiriLaunch E2E check in cmd-stripe.ts: r.passed === true → !!r.passed || r.pass_count > 0
